The program used its full €5M limit; no prior-period comparison was provided.
These shares will not be cancelled, limiting the reduction in shares outstanding from the program.
Remaining repurchased shares will be cancelled
Cancellation reduces the share count, though the release does not quantify the resulting change.
This is the company's stated post-cancellation holding; it represents a smaller treasury-share balance.

This completes the buyback announced in May 2026 and is a late confirmation of the program rather than a new authorization. The next relevant disclosure would be confirmation of the cancellation and its effect on the share count.
